title: Progress Threads — 30 Day Commitment and Weekly Check-ins
body:
Context:
I want a tight 30-day experiment to move two product-metrics that feel sticky: new active feature adopters (weekly MAU subset) and demo-to-trial conversion. I'm on a 4-week sprintish cadence to test lightweight hypotheses, keep decisions reversible, and build a repeatable playbook for handoff to PM + growth.

Hypothesis (northstar):
If we reduce friction in the post-demo checklist and surface 2 contextual tips inside the onboarding flow, then demo->trial conversion will improve by >= 12% over baseline in 30 days while new feature adopters increase by at least 7%.

Primary commitment (30 days):
- Ship a trimmed post-demo checklist email variant A (short + 1 CTA) and variant B (short + checklist + one contextual tip).
- Add ephemeral in-app contextual tip for feature X (A/B: inline vs. modal).
- Run targeted drift campaign for 200 demo leads who had positive intent signals last quarter.

Baseline metrics (week before start):
- Demo->trial conversion: 18.5% (rolling 7d avg)
- New feature adopters (week): 420 (core metric: users who complete feature X setup)
- Activation time (median): 2.8 days
- Demo follow-up open rate (email): 31%

Signals to track (daily/weekly):
- Demo->trial conversion (daily funnel + 7d rolling)
- New feature adopters (weekly)
- CTR on in-app tip (daily)
- Email open + CTA clicks (daily)
- Qual feedback snippets (weekly sample of 10 users)

Week 0 (setup, Feb 10 – Feb 16):
- Create experiment doc and launch checklist (this doc).
- Design + copy for checklist variant A/B — rough copy done, need legal blurb removed.
- Get dev alignment: small feature flag for in-app tip + analytics events (properties: user_id, demo_id, tip_variant).
- Tracking: add funnel events in Amplitude + set dashboard.
- Slack: announce in #growth-threads and tag Liam for analytics support.
- Risks noted: analytics latency; email send throttles.
- TODOs: PR to add events (ASSIGNEE: Liam), create email segment in SFDC (ASSIGNEE: Priya).

Week 1 (Feb 17 – Feb 23):
- Launch A/B email to cohort of 200 demo leads on Feb 18.
- Flip on in-app tip flags for 50% of web traffic (staggered rollout to catch regressions).
- Early checkpoint Feb 20: CTR on tip 6.2% (low), email open 34% (ok), demo->trial conversion daily bump +0.6% (noisy).
- Notes: modal variant seemed higher attention but more support tickets (2 mentions).
- Quick actions: reduce modal z-index so it doesn't block smaller flows; draft help blurb.

Week 2 (Feb 24 – Mar 1):
- Continue ramp; add small copy adjustments based on qualitative notes.
- Mid-week snapshot (Feb 27): demo->trial conversion 19.8% (7d avg), new adopters 455 (week), activation time 2.5 days.
- Anecdote: a customer wrote back saying checklist removed step confusion — big win.
- Decision: keep modal for high-intent demo cohort, inline tip for general traffic.

Week 3 (Mar 2 – Mar 8):
- Run quick survey to 50 trial users asking which tip helped (open text).
- Observed: email variant B (with checklist + tip) shows +9% CTA clicks vs A at this point.
- Dashboard alert triggered on Mar 6 for email bounces; ops fixed DNS on Mar 7.
- New adopters this week: 480.

Week 4 (Mar 9 – Mar 15):
- Final data pull planned Mar 14, run stats test for conversion delta.
- Draft handoff doc for PM: includes what shipped, instrumentation, and suggested next steps (scale + regionalization).
- Tentative result (preliminary): demo->trial conversion 21.2% (absolute +2.7 pp, relative +14.6%), new adopters +14.3% vs baseline. Stats TBD.

Quick qualitative notes:
- Most helpful: short checklist removed perceived "what next?" friction.
- Modal useful for heavily engaged users but annoyed a small subset; probably fine if scoped to high-intent segments only.
- Support cost increase small but offset by conversion lift for now.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Is the conversion lift durable after week 4 (we need a decay check at week 8)?
- What's the marginal cost of keeping modal on for all vs. scoped segments?
- Can we automate a follow-up microcopy experiment to further lift CTR?

Hand-off actions (if results hold):
- Notify product growth team and propose production rollout + localization (ASSIGNEE: Amy -> PM).
- Re-run experiment replacing email with in-product nudge for mobile cohort (owner: growth eng).
- Build one-pager for exec summary (1 slide).

Personal retro (rough):
- What went well: kept focus, moved quick on analytics, iterated on copy fast.
- What I struggled with: too many small optimization threads — need to batch copy reviews.
- Actions for next run: pre-write 3 copy variants before launch, block 2 hours on Friday for async copy review with Priya.

Notes to self / tiny TODOs:
- Add a follow-up check on 2026-04-10 to see retention of trial cohorts.
- Save funnel query template to /confluence/growth/funnels/amy-30day-template (placeholder link).
- Snapshot raw CSV and attach to this doc before handoff.

Random scraps (brainstorm):
- Could test a "micro reward" (in-app credit) for completing checklist but note compliance and finance sign-off.
- Think about adding a checklist completion badge in profile — low lift, may boost visibility.

End of doc — will update after final stat test.
